App Switcher Widget — Test Harness

Mimics a child app embedding the SignSuiteIQ app-switcher. Paste a widget token to render the floating grid in the top-right corner.

1. Get a widget token

Sign in to SignSuiteIQ, then have the API server issue you an SSO code and exchange it for a widget token:

POST /api/sso/issue  →  POST /api/sso/exchange  →  copy the widgetToken field.

2. Render the widget

Once mounted, look for the grid icon in the top-right corner. Click it to see the apps you can launch.
